name: GNOME Notches
description:
MacBook-style notches for the top bar and the dock.

The top bar becomes two islands (activities, places and clock on the left; tray icons and system menu on the right), three islands or a single notch, hanging from the top edge of the screen. The dock (Ubuntu Dock or Dash to Dock) becomes a notch glued to its screen edge.

Settings: notch color, layout, corner radius, gap from the screen edges, dock style on/off.

Note: the extension moves panel items between GNOME's left, center and right panel boxes (private API Main.panel._leftBox etc.) and restores them exactly on disable.
